name: Date Difference Calculator
summary: Find the difference between two dates in years, months, days, weeks, and more — locally.
description: Pick a start and end date to see calendar difference (Y/M/D), total days, weeks, and derived hours/minutes/seconds. Handles reverse order with signed day counts. Leap years included via UTC calendar math.

faqs.question: How is the calendar difference calculated?
faqs.answer: Years, months, and days use the same borrowing rules as exact-age math between the earlier and later date.

faqs.question: What if the end date is before the start?
faqs.answer: Signed days become negative. The Y/M/D breakdown still shows the absolute span between the two dates.

faqs.question: Do hours include time of day?
faqs.answer: No. Inputs are calendar dates; hours/minutes/seconds are absoluteDays × 24/60/60.

faqs.question: Is my data uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculations run entirely in your browser.
